WHO ARE THIS PHAT BREW CLUB BUNCH?

The Phat Brew Club Crew



When mates get together to brew a beer, it often doesn't start with commercial ambitions, instead just being a way to catch up - but sometimes it turns into much much more........

Phat Brew Club was formed by a bunch of mates who met at their local football club and decided to get into homebrewing together. Regular brew days and a passion for good beer led to the group deciding to make the leap and start to can and keg their brews for everyone to enjoy.

The dream was really kicked off in 2020, when the group of mates won the Margaret River Brewhouse Backyard Brewing competition with their Coffee Cream Porter; their prize included brewing their award-winning recipe on the MRB kit and having it poured at the venue. It was an opportunity that gave the ambitious garage brewers a push to take things further.

“The win gave us the confidence that our beers were good enough to be brewed at a commercial scale,” says Trav, one of PBC Crew. 

“After having the opportunity to commercially brew Phat Porter with Margaret River Brewhouse, we set up the company and went about brewing our first release, a Fruit Salad Sour called Phatizzle.”

Phat Brew Club is about having fun together and creating a culture of good times where everyone can be a part of it. We pride ourselves on creating beers that “live on the edge” and bringing people together, while brewing creatively without limits.


Awards

2026 Perth Royal Beer Awards Best Lager (Draught) Trophy for Darth Lager and 13 medals across multiple styles including gold medals for Darth Lager and Phat Porter
2025 The Catering Institute of Australia - Gold Plate Award for West Australia's Best Brewery
2025 Perth Royal Beer Awards - 12 medals across 7 styles, including gold for Back in Black and Darth Lager
2024 Perth Royal Beer Awards - 9 medals across 6 styles
2024 Australian Independent Beer Awards - 13 medals, 3 gold indies and Top 3 Champion West Australian Breweries
2023 Perth Royal Beer Awards - 9 medals across 5 styles
2023 The Catering Institute of Australia - Finalist for West Australia's Best Brewery
2021 GABS Hottest 100 New Beers - Phat n Juicy and Strawberry Fields made the top 100 of new beers brewed
2020 Margaret River Brewhouse Backyard Brewing - Champion with Coffee Cream Porter

Phat Brew Club News
New West Perth Weekly Specials

Big Phat Daily Specials Are Here at West Perth
If you're looking for an excuse to visit Phat Brew Club West Perth during the week, we've got five of them.

Our new Big Phat Daily Specials deliver incredible value, seriously good food and, of course, the perfect excuse to enjoy a fresh Phat beer brewed right here on site.

Monday – Mega Burger Monday | $25
Kick the week off with your choice of a Double Oklahoma Smash Burger or Nashville Chicken Burger, both served with chips.

Tuesday – Big Schnitty Energy | $25
A proper pub schnitty loaded with prosciutto, olive tapenade and goat feta, served alongside crispy chips.

Wednesday – Phat Pasta Party | $25
Choose from three house-made pasta favourites:

Spaghetti Bolognese
Gnocchi alla Norma
Orecchiette

Plus selected jugs from just $20 from 5pm.

Thursday – Mondo's Steak Night
Premium cuts supplied by Mondo Butcher & Grocer, flame grilled to perfection:

200g Flank Steak – $29
250g Rostbiff Rump – $39
250g Sirloin – $54
300g Rump Cap – $54


Sunday – Roast Sunday | $35
This month's roast is a cracker. Enjoy slow-roasted pork belly served with a house-made Scotch egg, minted peas, roasted spring onion and rich gravy. A proper Sunday roast done right.

Happy Hour
Monday to Friday | 5pm–6pm

$9 pints of West is Best Lager
$7 house wines

With 20 beers on tap brewed by our team in West Perth, there has never been a better time to make Phat Brew Club your local.

Book a table, grab some mates and make your way through the week, one special at a time.


New Hillarys Weekly Specials

Daily Specials Have Arrived at Phat Brew Club Hillarys
Great beer, waterfront views and a reason to visit every day of the week.

Our new Daily Specials menu at Hillarys is packed with big flavours, great value and the perfect excuse to settle in overlooking the marina.

Whether you're chasing loaded tacos, premium steaks, all-you-can-eat ribs or a classic Sunday roast, there's something happening every day.

Monday – Big Phat Sandos | $35
Start the week strong with our epic Handlebar Beef Rib Double Cheeseburger, served with a West is Best Lager middy. Big, messy and absolutely worth it.

Tuesday – Taco Tuesday | $15
Three loaded tacos packed with flavour and guaranteed to disappear quickly. Perfect with a cold beer overlooking the water.

Wednesday – Mondo's Steak Night
Premium cuts supplied by Mondo Butcher & Grocer, cooked to perfection. Choose from two quality steak options and enjoy one of the best steak nights in the northern suburbs.

Thursday – All-You-Can-Eat Ribs | $50
Bring your appetite. Enjoy unlimited ribs for up to 90 minutes. Napkins highly recommended.

Friday – Special Cocktails | $15
From 8pm, sip and savour a rotating selection of cocktails for just $15. The perfect way to kick off your weekend by the marina.

Sunday – Roast Sundays | $35
A proper Sunday roast with all the trimmings. Comfort food done right, best enjoyed with a fresh Phat beer and a view of the harbour.

Happy Hour
Monday to Friday | 5pm–6pm
Enjoy selected pints for $9 and wines or sparkling for just $7 while taking in one of Perth's best waterfront locations.

With 20 beers brewed by our team at Phat Brew Club, incredible marina views and a different special every day, there's never been a better time to make Hillarys your local.

Don't forget that Wednesday nights are Quiz Nights at Phat West Perth. The Bamboozled Team do a great job of making this a must-attend every week. Great prizes and a great atmosphere for those who love pushing the grey matter to the limit.

Phat HQ Clubrooms – West Perth’s Home of Craft Beer & Good Times

Welcome to Phat HQ, winner of 2025 Gold Plate for WA's best brewery, the original home of Phat Brew Club and the beating heart of our Culture of Good Times. Located directly opposite City West Train Station in West Perth, this is where the energy starts — a 450-person venue and beer garden built for big beers, big flavours and big fun.
Whether you’re here for a casual pint, a long lunch, a family outing or a full-blown celebration, Phat HQ is Perth’s go-to spot for craft beer, comfort food and all-day good vibes.


What’s Pouring – 20 Fresh Phat Brews on Tap

With 20 taps pouring fresh WA craft beer, Phat HQ is where you’ll find the latest seasonal releases, limited drops and all your Phat favourites:

West is Best Lager
Culture of Good Times Hazy IPA
Risky Business WCIPA
Ginger Ninja Ginger Beer
Xtra Phat Ale
Rotating collabs & seasonal taps
Experimental brews straight from the brewery

For the live tap list CLICK HERE, so you always know what’s pouring right now.

Food That Hits the Spot

Brewery food at Phat HQ is bold, generous and built for good times. From wings, bao and loaded share plates to our cult-favourite burgers, charcoal-grilled steaks and beer-battered WA barramundi, everything is made to go perfectly with our 20 taps pouring fresh Phat brews.
Whether you’re rolling in for a quick bite, a long lunch or a big night, our West Perth kitchen keeps it fun, flavour-forward and family-friendly — with kids’ meals, great value and options for every appetite.

CLICK HERE to see food menu

FAQ

Are you dog-friendly?
Yes — dogs are welcome in the outdoor beer garden.
Do you take walk-ins?
Absolutely. Walk-ins are welcome every day.
Is there parking?
Yes — plenty of nearby paid and street parking.
Is Phat HQ kid-friendly?
Very. Sandpit, arcade, kids’ menu and heaps of room.
Can I order from my table?
Yes — ME&U ordering is available throughout the venue.
